headline: Russian Oil Tankers Deploy Makeshift Drone Defenses Amid Attacks
summary: Russian oil tankers are deploying makeshift drone defenses following attacks linked to the conflict in Ukraine.
why: Security measures on energy transport vessels reflect ongoing risks to maritime supply chains and Russian petroleum exports.

impacts.name: Urals crude
impacts.why: Tanker defense deployments highlight heightened security risks in Russian oil shipping routes.
